basic_identification.full_title: Jute Agro-Textile — Sapling Bags for Growth of Seedling/Sapling — Specification
basic_identification.sector_category: Technical Textiles / Technical Textiles for Agrotech Applications (approved by the Textile Division Council and finalized by the Technical Textiles for Agrotech Sectional Committee of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

sectional_committee.name: Technical Textiles for Agrotech Sectional Committee

scope.summary: This standard specifies the material, construction, physical, and mechanical requirements, along with corresponding test methods, for biodegradable jute sapling bags manufactured from woven hessian cloth. These bags are designed for nursery use to cultivate seedlings and saplings before transplanting them into open fields, forestry zones, or horticultural developments, providing a natural, root-aerating, and plastic-free alternative.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Specification (Agrotech Textiles / Biodegradable Jute Bags)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Strict Statutory Mandatory Certification. Under the 'Agro Textiles (Quality Control) Order' (QCO) issued by the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, all Jute Sapling Bags for the growth of seedlings/saplings manufactured, imported, distributed, or sold in India must conform to IS 16089:2013 and bear the mandatory BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Manufacturing, importing, or selling non-certified sapling bags in the domestic market is a statutory offense under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. MSMEs are granted phased transition timelines, and export-only shipments are exempt. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable to biodegradable jute bags.

requirements.detail: Every commercial pack or bundle of sapling bags must bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) along with the manufacturer's registered licence number (CM/L) and standard designation (IS 16089) printed on a secure label or packaging.

The sapling bags must be manufactured from natural, high-purity woven hessian cloth of specified GSM (typically standard 272 g/m²). Synthetic blending or toxic chemical treatments that would compromise soil biodegradability or plant root systems are strictly prohibited.
The length, width, and shape of the sapling bags must be declared by the manufacturer for the scope of the licence to match different crop variety and seedling root requirements.

The warp yarn count (Ends per unit length) and weft yarn count (Picks per unit length) must satisfy specified limits to ensure a tight, uniform weave that retains soil and moisture while allowing root aeration.

The hessian fabric must resist handling stresses: tensile breaking strength in both Machine Direction (MD) and Cross Direction (CD) must satisfy specified minimum load thresholds when tested per IS 1969.

To prevent structural blowout along the joints when filled with heavy, wet nursery soil, the stitched seams of the bag must satisfy a specified minimum seam strength when evaluated in accordance with IS 9030.

requirements.requirement_type: Amended Water Holding Capacity (Clause C-1 - Amended)
requirements.detail:
Under Amendment No. 1, to evaluate moisture-retention capability, the water holding capacity must be tested as per Annex C and calculated using the corrected formula:
Water holding capacity = [ W1 / ((W2 - X) - W1) ] * 100 percent
where W1 is the mass of the dry jute specimen, W2 is the mass of the saturated specimen with the testing apparatus, and X is the mass of the empty wet testing apparatus.

The finished sapling bags must be clean, dry, of uniform weave, and completely free from manufacturing defects, oil spots, mold, decay, or visible holes (excluding standard weave porosity). They must be stored in dry, well-ventilated spaces prior to shipment to prevent premature decay.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 16089 : 2013 is the mandatory national Indian Standard specification governing biodegradable jute agro-textile sapling bags manufactured from woven hessian cloth (typically standard 272 g/m²), used in nurseries, forestry, and horticultural projects for raising young seedlings and saplings before field transplantation. Under India's statutory Agro Textiles Quality Control Order (QCO), all sapling bags supplied to the Indian market must be certified by the Bureau of Indian Standards and bear the Standard Mark (ISI Mark). The standard regulates bag dimensions, weave density, tensile strength (warp/weft), and stitched seam strength to prevent soil blowout during handling. Amendment No. 1 (October 2022) corrects the standard water holding capacity formula to accurately measure the fabric's moisture absorption and retention, ensuring a healthy, aerated, and ecologically safe root-zone micro-climate.
